description: Runs the monitor as SYSTEM on a runner without UniFi Endpoint. It must stay healthy by default, alert when alertIfMissing is on, and turn an out-of-range variable into a 'Check could not run' alert - each with exactly the documented exit code and a result block. The installed/behind paths need the product present and are exercised by the component's own test and the first internal run.

steps.label: Not installed: healthy
outputContains: STATUS=UniFi Endpoint is not installed; nothing to check.

steps.label: Not installed with alertIfMissing: alert
outputContains: STATUS=UniFi Endpoint is not installed on this device (alertIfMissing is on).

steps.label: Out-of-range cacheHours: check could not run
